title: Oculus VR: timing coordination, not specs
summary: VR made people sick not because displays were low-resolution but because display latency, head tracking and rendering were out of sync, producing a sensory conflict. Oculus coordinated the three timings until the latency was imperceptible.
source: Ch02 — Palmer Luckey, 'Coordination Beats Optimization Every Time'
